name: Verifed V29.1
description: Fixes Home's Warm Forest hero where the heading and dietary guidance overflowed the green panel into the food image. Uses separate flexible text/photo columns, a smaller responsive title and a compact CTA so copy wraps entirely over a dark background at phone sizes.
verification: The Home hero now lays out text and imagery in non-overlapping columns rather than overlaying 71%-width text on a 54%-width dark mask.
The headline, guidance and Explore menus CTA retain their intended wording and working Explore route.
The hero content grows vertically with text; no fixed-height clipping or opaque image overlay is needed.
All five featured menus, V29 navigation, Journal, welcome, Taco Bell and Chipotle styling remain unchanged.
Node regression tests run during GitHub Actions Snack publishing. A live native visual capture is not asserted.
